annotations.title: Check a claim against DFX's evidence

description: A claim in, SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or UNKNOWN out, with the cited evidence rows. Names resolve only to records carrying that name; absence of evidence is UNKNOWN, never a contradiction.

as_of.description: ISO date the claim is about, for lending and position claims that do not state one.

object_dfx_id.description: A DFX id: dfx:fo:<uuid> (family office graph), dfx:isi:<uuid> (sponsor graph), dfx:vc:<uuid> (venture graph), dfx:pe:<uuid> (private equity graph), dfx:ria:<uuid> (registered investment adviser graph), dfx:al:<uuid> (allocator graph), dfx:pc:<uuid> (private credit graph), dfx:ref:<uuid> (real estate fund graph), or a bare real estate UUID.
